title: Healthy Smoked Canadian Smoked Salmon Skewers
description: A funky and tender crowd-pleaser featuring smoked salmon, this dish is perfect for any occasion, with a hint of yellow food colouring for added fun
instructions: Preheat the smoker to 225 degrees Fahrenheit
Cut the smoked salmon into 1 inch pieces and set aside
In a small bowl, mix together the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
Add the yellow food colouring to the bowl and mix until combined
Thread the salmon pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Brush the skewers with the lemon juice mixture
Place the skewers in the smoker and smoke for 30 minutes
Add the wood chips to the smoker and continue to smoke for an additional 10 minutes
Remove the skewers from the smoker and garnish with chopped parsley
